faq.q: Can I make explainer or training videos from images?
faq.a: Yes. Add a voice and AI actor to explain a product or teach a short lesson. You can update the words later without filming again.

faq.q: How does AI turn a photo into a video?
faq.a: Upload the photo and describe how you want it to move. Add a voice or captions, then generate a video in a few minutes.

faq.q: Which video sizes does image-to-video support?
faq.a: Choose 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, square 1:1 in feeds, or widescreen 16:9 for YouTube. You can also use 4:3 or 3:4.

faq.q: Can I add a voice or AI actor to an image video?
faq.a: Yes. Write what you want said, choose a voice, and add an AI actor if you want someone on screen.

faq.q: Why make a video from a product photo?
faq.a: You can turn photos you already own into videos without booking a shoot. Make more versions for ads, product pages, or social posts in minutes.

faq.q: Can I post image-to-video clips on social media?
faq.a: Yes. Download clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or other social channels. Choose the size that fits each placement.

faq.q: How can online stores use image-to-video?
faq.a: Turn product photos into short demos, social ads, or listing videos. You can try different scenes from the same photo without another shoot.

faq.q: How can AI turn my photo into a video?
faq.a: It turns a still photo into a short video with movement. Add a voice, captions, or an AI actor to make a product clip without filming.
